commands.command: Audit hidden dynamics and capability-envelope causes of M148 P0-close target-divergent pairs without feeding those hidden values to the actor.
commands.name: m150_p0_close_hidden_cause_audit

decision_rule: Use hidden causes only as diagnostic/teacher targets; if P0-close pairs are explained by hidden dynamics, build a belief or active-identification objective rather than expanding deployable actor inputs.
failure_criteria: hidden parameters are proposed as actor inputs
audit ignores the M148 P0-close pair surface
results come from one seed only
cause labels are reported without linking them to future-envelope target gaps
hypothesis: M148 P0-close target-divergent pairs are likely caused by hidden dynamics or capability-envelope differences that passive raw wheel/vparallel cues do not target-align; identifying those causes can define better belief-learning or active-probing targets.
success_criteria: consume M148/M149 P0-close pairs across at least three seeds
report hidden dynamics differences and future-envelope target differences separately
rank likely cause groups such as friction, braking authority, yaw/lateral authority, and actuator delay
record training-time belief or active-identification targets without changing actor inputs
